conviction_note: The release is at 16:00 JST (after the close) and no forecast revision, shareholder return or H1 guide is expected, so this print is a Q1 judged against last year's weak Q1. The company figures cannot be pinned down: the ad-spend base effect (+) and the content and kitting run-rate (-) roughly offset. What leans negative is how this name reacts. Its first session after 6 of the last 8 releases fell, including both Q1 prints (-6.56%, -8.33%), and leveraged retail is crowded long at a margin ratio of 8.23. Findings sum to -1.9 against a scaled -0.64 (p_up 42, abs 4.0). The gap is there because most of the negatives are public series or reaction patterns, and LESSONS rule 1 moves p_up toward 50 for those.
bar: There is no consensus (kabuyoho shows none: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=4829) and no H1 guide (the company omits it, citing annual management; FY2026 短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591232.pdf). The bar used is the FY2027 plan's +7.9% revenue growth applied to Q1 FY26 revenue of 1,082m, i.e. ~1,167m, plus last year's Q1 op of -11m and ordinary of 5m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4829). My own Q1 revenue estimate is ~1,100m (content -50, business support +35, solution +35), about -4 to -6% against that bar. The bar is self-constructed, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=4829): longs 908.0k shares against shorts 110.3k on 10/02, ratio 8.23. Shorts halved from 232.1k a week earlier while longs rose from 840.1k. Margin longs are about 4.5 days of the ~200k-share daily volume. There is no option skew in Japan. A crowded leveraged long with shrinking short-cover fuel is the setup in which a weak print still finds sellers.

findings.finding: This stock has fallen in the first session after 6 of its last 8 results releases (-6.56, -5.69, -4.55, 0.0, -8.33, -0.88, -8.46, +0.95). Both Q1 prints were sold: -6.56% on 2024-10-07 after the 2024-10-04 release and -8.33% on 2025-10-14 after the 2025-10-10 release. Q1 (Jun-Aug) is structurally its weak quarter (op 1m and -11m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line: Q1 releases were followed by -6.56% (FY25 Q1) and -8.33% (FY26 Q1). FY26 Q1 was sold even though management said 'business expansion in line with the initial plan'.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's history uses estimated dates and a 3.31% median; the measured post-release sessions show a median absolute move of ~5.1% and a negative skew. If the market had priced a repeat, the stock would already have derated into the print, but the 20-day run-up is only -4.6% and margin longs are rising, not exiting.
findings.independence: The positioning finding below (margin longs rising to 908k, ratio 8.23, kabutan) is a different source that points the same way.

findings.finding: Q1 FY26 carried 31m of advertising (up 116.5% YoY) against 52m for the whole of FY26, so Q1 FY27 inherits a base effect of about +20m on an operating base of -11m. Ordinary profit's base is only 5m, so even a modestly positive Q1 prints as a multiple-fold YoY rise in kabutan's headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last Q1 the headline was '6-8月期(1Q)経常は38％減益で着地' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4829&b=k202510100121) and the stock fell 8.33%. The headline direction can flip this year on the low base.
findings.why_not_priced: It needs the Q1 FY26 presentation's cost split put next to the FY26 full-year ad total (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593403.pdf). This is a ¥4bn name with no analyst coverage, and nobody publishes a Q1 estimate.
findings.independence: Two company documents (the Q1 FY26 and FY26 presentations). Nothing independent.

findings.finding: Content-service revenue fell from 244m in Q1 FY26 to 213, 199 and ~193m over the next three quarters (-19.3% for the year) after the ad push was abandoned. At that run-rate Q1 FY27 content revenue is about 50m lower YoY, and it is high-margin revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Content decline was cited in the FY26 results (stock +0.95% on 2026-07-13) and in the Q3 cut (-8.46% on 2026-04-10, but that was a forecast revision).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The quarterly series is in the last presentation and anyone can extrapolate it, so this is sized near zero. What is left is that it offsets the ad-cost tailwind.
findings.independence: Same company document family as the ad finding, but a different line.

findings.finding: Kitting support, which the company named as FY26's profit driver and plans to grow in FY27 'on device-replacement demand', faces a falling PC market. JEITA Japan PC shipments fell 23.1% YoY in Apr-Jun 2026 (the third straight monthly decline, a reaction to the Windows 10 EOS and GIGA demand), and MM Research forecasts FY2026 shipments down 37.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. Kitting has never been the line a print turned on.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission is unproven. The Q1 FY26 business-support base was its lowest of the year (168m) and Q4 FY26 still ran +46% YoY (217m vs 149m), so the YoY comparison in Q1 may hold up. The series is public, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: MM Research FY2026 forecast via https://pc.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/2112527.html (2026-05-28) points the same way.

findings.finding: Margin longs rose to 908.0k shares while margin shorts halved from 232.1k to 110.3k in the week to 2026-10-02, taking 信用倍率 from 3.62 to 8.23. Leveraged retail is crowded long into the print with little short-cover fuel left.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior measurement of margin data on this name's prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's margin_overhang component (-0.46) already holds the level. What is added here is the change: shorts covered before the print, so the squeeze leg that cushions a weak print is gone.
findings.independence: JPX register shows 0% disclosed short (baseline), consistent with a thin short side.

findings.finding: Q1 FY27 SG&A carries new structural costs that did not exist a year ago: holding-company transition work (split agreements 2026-07-24, effective 2026-12-01), a stock-option grant (2026-07-24), the newly consolidated NE Investment, and the 51%-owned grid-battery JV NE Power, founded in early August.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference; the company says the JV's impact is 'limited'. The cost lines are small but land on an operating base of near zero.
findings.independence: Holding-company split agreement https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260724/140120260724599395.pdf (same date, same issuer).

outside_window.finding: The holding-company structure takes effect on 2026-12-01 (articles of incorporation filed 2026-08-28), and NE Power's grid-battery capex is still to come.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. The company manages annually, has no H1 guide and historically revised at Q3 (April 2026, -56% ordinary). Returns: none expected (year-end dividend only, no buyback history). New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter vs its own Q1 history: op 1m (FY25) and -11m (FY26), against FY op of 67 and 82, so Q1 progress is near 0% in both years. A near-zero Q1 is normal, and it was still sold both times.

rejected_candidates.detail: A PR item on the kitting line. It is merged into the kitting finding as context and carries no money of its own.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Death of an outside auditor and petition for a temporary auditor
rejected_candidates.detail: The document states it is a statutory vacancy being filled by a court-appointed lawyer, with no accounting issue. It does not bear on the print.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the baseline's mild negative lean (-0.23, driven by margin overhang) and with the -4.6% 20-day drift. The strongest positive the release could carry is a positive Q1 ordinary profit on a 5m base, which would produce a 'multiple-fold YoY increase' headline, helped by ~20m of ad-spend base effect. I looked for a buyback, a dividend change or a revision and found no sign of any.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the content decline cut from -0.6 to -0.3 and the JEITA kitting proxy from -0.4 to -0.3, both being computable from public documents; p_up moved from 40 to 42.
Rule 1 / core table: the reaction-history finding cut from -1.5 to -1.2, because a pattern anyone can see on the chart is partly held by the price.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (the low-base ordinary headline and the ad tailwind) into baseline_tension and confirmed that I searched for returns and revisions. Left the ad-tailwind finding at +0.7.
Margin-ratio finding left at -0.5: the hunter definition names a crowded margin long as the one setup where a visible weakness still has sellers.
